content.query:
create external data source bronze_source
with (
    location = 'https://ecomdevstore1.blob.core.windows.net/bronze/'
)

create external file format DeltaFormat
with(
    FORMAT_TYPE = delta
)

create external table dbo.customers
(
    customer_id INT,
    tax_id DOUBLE PRECISION,
    tax_code VARCHAR(50),
    customer_name VARCHAR(255),
    state VARCHAR(100),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    postcode VARCHAR(20),
    street VARCHAR(255),
    number VARCHAR(50),
    unit VARCHAR(50),
    region VARCHAR(100),
    district VARCHAR(100),
    lon DOUBLE PRECISION,
    lat DOUBLE PRECISION,
    ship_to_address VARCHAR(500),
    valid_from INT,
    valid_to DOUBLE PRECISION,
    units_purchased INT,
    loyalty_segment INT,
    file_path VARCHAR(1000), 
    last_update_ts DATETIME

)
with(
    location = 'customers/',
    Data_source = bronze_source,
    file_format = DeltaFormat
)
